notes: TBox delete of a stored rule. Members stay members in every world; a world with the member's value stored by name keeps it, a world that reached it only through the rule loses it (stores). The rule is scoped to British laymen (KnightBachelor and BritishLayman); the prompts say the new members are British laymen (given) and the well-known members' layman status is firm, so only the knighthood gives way. One style before a name: a local functional relation, as in the record's axiom.
original: KnightBachelor and BritishLayman ⊑ entitled_to_style value sir
